answer: The ferrous test I would run is Heat pump installation certificate with MCS registration: a heat pump certified under the MCS scheme, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a heat pump certified under the MCS scheme stays private; the nectar is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the sparrow of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
